note: Art styles are not owned, but specific characters, costumes, logos and signature designs are. Presets describe general styles for ORIGINAL characters only.

big_bold_first.label: Big & bold – first coloring
big_bold_first.description: One big, friendly subject built from a few jumbo shapes, with extra-thick lines and almost no background. The easiest style for little hands and chunky crayons.
big_bold_first.best_for: First coloring books, toddlers and preschoolers, early learners
big_bold_first.prompt_style: very simple preschool coloring page, one big friendly subject, extra-thick smooth outlines, jumbo rounded shapes
big_bold_first.detail_level: Very low – one subject made of about 8–20 big shapes
big_bold_first.coloring_spaces: Jumbo spaces only; nothing smaller than a thumbprint
big_bold_first.background_density: None or almost none – a ground line, a cloud or a sun at most
avoid_extra: more than two characters in one picture
subjects: a cupcake with a cherry on top
a bouncy ball with a star
activities: a plain page with one cloud
a crescent moon and one star
compositions: one subject centered and filling most of the page
subject very large with a simple ground line
big_bold_first.master_style: Coloring page for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 3–5). Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Extra-thick, smooth, even outlines (about 2–3 mm when printed). ONE big, friendly subject that fills most of the page, made of about 8–20 large rounded shapes, each at least the size of a thumbprint. Little or no background: a ground line, a cloud or a sun at most. Simple, happy face.

cute_animal_friends.label: Cute animal friends
cute_animal_friends.description: Chubby, rounded animals with big eyes and happy faces, plus one or two simple props. Soft and cuddly, easy to color.
cute_animal_friends.best_for: Animal books, bedtime and friendship themes
cute_animal_friends.prompt_style: cute rounded cartoon animals, chubby bodies, big friendly eyes, soft simple shapes, thick clean outlines
cute_animal_friends.outline_weight: Thick, soft, rounded outlines (about 1.5–2 mm printed)
cute_animal_friends.detail_level: Low – one or two animals with one or two simple props
cute_animal_friends.coloring_spaces: Large rounded spaces; fur drawn as a smooth outline, never as strokes
cute_animal_friends.background_density: Sparse – two or three simple objects such as flowers, a tree or clouds
activities: a picnic blanket on the grass
a meadow with a few flowers
compositions: one animal large in the center
two animal friends side by side
animal close-up with a big smile and one prop
cute_animal_friends.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 3–6. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Thick, soft, rounded outlines (about 1.5–2 mm when printed). Cute cartoon animals with chubby rounded bodies, big friendly eyes and happy faces; fur is a smooth outline, never strokes. One or two animals large in the middle with one or two simple props, and only two or three simple background objects. Every space is at least the size of a fingertip.

classic_cartoon.label: Classic cartoon
classic_cartoon.description: Round, friendly shapes and bold outlines. The default for ages 4–7.
classic_cartoon.background_density: Sparse – a few large background objects
classic_cartoon.coloring_spaces: Mostly large spaces; avoid regions smaller than a fingertip
classic_cartoon.prompt_style: classic friendly cartoon style, rounded shapes, thick clean outlines
classic_cartoon.best_for: Any kids' theme – the safe default
classic_cartoon.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Classic friendly cartoon style with round shapes and bold, uniform outlines (about 1–1.5 mm when printed). One main subject, large and clear, with a few large background objects. Every space is at least the size of a fingertip.

storybook_adventure.label: Storybook adventure
storybook_adventure.description: Picture-book scenes that tell one moment of a story: characters large in front, a few simple background objects behind. Made for books with a plot and recurring characters.
storybook_adventure.best_for: Story-driven books with recurring characters (adventures, rescues, quests)
storybook_adventure.prompt_style: gentle picture-book cartoon style, rounded friendly characters with expressive faces, one clear story moment, thick clean outlines
storybook_adventure.outline_weight: Bold, even outlines (about 1.5–2 mm printed), slightly thinner lines only for faces
storybook_adventure.detail_level: Low to medium – one clear scene with the characters large and in front
storybook_adventure.coloring_spaces: Large and medium spaces; nothing smaller than a fingertip
storybook_adventure.background_density: Light – three to five simple background objects (a tree, a house, a hill), no textures
avoid_extra: crowded scenes with many small figures
detailed textures on walls, grass or water
activities: a winding path toward distant hills
the trunk of a giant tree
an attic with a big trunk
a tent and a small campfire
compositions: main characters large in the foreground with a simple setting behind
two characters interacting in the center
wide scene with a clear horizon and big characters
close-up of a character reacting with a big expression
storybook_adventure.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Bold, smooth, even outlines (about 1.5–2 mm when printed). Gentle picture-book cartoon style with rounded shapes and friendly, expressive faces. The page shows one clear moment of the story: the main characters are large and in front, with only three to five simple background objects. Every shape is at least the size of a fingertip, easy to color with crayons.

vehicles_machines.label: Trucks, vehicles & machines
vehicles_machines.description: Chunky, toy-like vehicles with big wheels, big windows and simple parts. Gears, ladders and hoses are drawn few and large.
vehicles_machines.best_for: Rescue crews, construction, trains, boats, rockets and gadgets
vehicles_machines.prompt_style: chunky toy-like cartoon vehicles, big round wheels, big windows, simple mechanical parts as large shapes, thick clean outlines
vehicles_machines.detail_level: Low to medium – big body panels, few and large bolts, gears and lights
vehicles_machines.coloring_spaces: Large body panels, wheels and windows; no thin grilles or tiny rivets
vehicles_machines.background_density: Light – a road, a ground line or a few simple buildings
avoid_extra: realistic engine detail or thin grilles
real vehicle brands, logos or license plates
activities: a curvy road with a few trees
a construction site with a sand pile
a launch pad and a few stars
compositions: one vehicle large and side-on across the page
vehicle in three-quarter view with a driver waving
two vehicles working together
vehicles_machines.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Bold, smooth, even outlines (about 1.5–2 mm when printed). Chunky, rounded, toy-like vehicles and machines with big wheels and big windows; gears, ladders, hoses and bolts are drawn few and large, never as thin grilles or tiny rivets. Drivers and riders are large and friendly. Background kept to a road, a ground line or a few simple shapes. No lettering, logos or license plates.

sticker_bubble.label: Sticker style
sticker_bubble.description: Each character or object looks like a sticker: a thick outline around the whole figure, simple inside lines and clear white space around it.
sticker_bubble.best_for: Character sheets, 'meet the crew' pages, collections such as fruits, pets or toys
sticker_bubble.prompt_style: sticker-style cartoon figures, very thick outer outline around each figure, simple inner lines, white space around each figure
sticker_bubble.outline_weight: Very thick outer contour (about 2.5 mm printed) with thinner inside lines (about 1 mm)
sticker_bubble.coloring_spaces: Large spaces; each figure stands alone with white space around it
sticker_bubble.background_density: None – white space between the figures
subjects: a collection of cute sea creatures
compositions: one sticker-like character centered and large
three or four sticker-like figures spread out with space between them
sticker_bubble.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Sticker style: every character or object has a very thick outer outline around the whole figure (about 2.5 mm when printed) and only a few simpler lines inside. Figures do not overlap and have clear white space around them; no scenery. Rounded, cheerful shapes, each at least the size of a fingertip.

crayon_doodle.label: Hand-drawn doodle
crayon_doodle.description: Playful, hand-drawn marker look with slightly wobbly lines – like a fun drawing by a friendly grown-up. Lines still meet, so shapes stay closed.
crayon_doodle.best_for: Silly, playful books: monsters, food, school, holidays
crayon_doodle.prompt_style: playful hand-drawn marker doodle style, slightly wobbly but confident lines, simple cheerful shapes
crayon_doodle.outline_weight: Thick marker-like lines (about 1.5–2 mm printed), slightly wobbly but always joined
crayon_doodle.detail_level: Low – simple doodled shapes with a few fun details
crayon_doodle.coloring_spaces: Large spaces; every line meets the next so shapes are closed
crayon_doodle.background_density: Sparse – a few doodled stars, hearts, swirls or squiggles kept large
activities: a few doodled crumbs and hearts
compositions: one doodled character large in the center
two doodled friends having fun together
crayon_doodle.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Playful hand-drawn marker doodle style: thick lines (about 1.5–2 mm when printed) that are slightly wobbly but confident, with no sketchy double lines and no gaps, so every shape stays closed. Simple, silly, cheerful shapes, large enough to color with crayons; any doodled stars, hearts or swirls in the background are few and large.

hidden_object_fun.label: Find-and-color
hidden_object_fun.description: A simple scene with 5–8 easy-to-spot objects to find (a star, a key, a fish…). Each one is drawn clearly with its own outline, still big enough to color.
hidden_object_fun.best_for: Activity books, 'find the hidden …' features, quiet-time books
hidden_object_fun.prompt_style: simple cartoon scene with a few hidden objects to find, each object clearly drawn and separated, thick clean outlines
hidden_object_fun.detail_level: Medium – one scene plus 5–8 findable objects, nothing tiny
hidden_object_fun.coloring_spaces: Medium and large spaces; each hidden object at least the size of a fingertip
hidden_object_fun.background_density: Medium – a simple scene with room for the hidden objects
avoid_extra: dense patterns that hide objects too well
activities: a park with bushes and a slide
compositions: wide simple scene with objects spread around the page
one big character in a scene with objects hidden around it
hidden_object_fun.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 5–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Bold, even outlines (about 1.5 mm when printed). A simple cartoon scene with five to eight easy-to-spot objects hidden in it (for example a star, a key, a fish, a cup), each drawn clearly with its own closed outline, not overlapping other details, and at least the size of a fingertip. Friendly rounded characters, large and clear.

fairytale_magic.best_for: Fantasy, princess-and-knight, dragon and magic themes (original characters)
fairytale_magic.prompt_style: whimsical fairy-tale cartoon style, rounded castles, friendly magical creatures, big simple stars and sparkles, thick clean outlines
fairytale_magic.detail_level: Low – magical scenes with big simple shapes; sparkles drawn as a few large stars
fairytale_magic.coloring_spaces: Large spaces; dresses, capes and wings as big shapes without ruffles or patterns

fairytale_magic.master_style: Children's coloring book page for ages 4–7. Pure white background, black line art only: no gray, no shading, no hatching, no tiny patterns or textures. Every shape is fully closed so it can be colored in. Portrait page with everything inside the margins. Bold, smooth outlines (about 1.5–2 mm when printed). Whimsical fairy-tale cartoon style: rounded castles, friendly original magical creatures and characters with happy faces.
